text: Digi Field App helps engineers analyze device telemetry, verify network connectivity, and document field measurements. Clear diagnostics and structured reports support faster troubleshooting and more precise technical decisions on site.

variants.instructions: Use a natural adult feminine voice in neutral American English. Introduce the app with fresh, lively product-demo energy, a clear bright tone, and a confident conversational smile. Keep the rhythm brisk and smooth, with natural pitch variation and a friendly sense of discovery. Read only the supplied sentence. Pronounce Digi as dih-jee. Make the product name stand out with a tiny pause, then flow naturally to engineers. Clean spoken narration.
